notes.title: Updates and Clarifications Regarding MODs
notes.content: [h3][b]MOD Remaster Related[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Recently, we received reports that some native characters could not enter Chapter 4 of the Yao-Slaying Tower. After investigation, we found that this issue was caused by certain “Modified Starting Deck” MODs that did not include the “Chapter 4 Initial Event.”[/p][p]We have uploaded fixed versions of these MODs to the Workshop. Below is a list of the updated MODs—please subscribe to the new versions if you are using them.[/p][p]If the original authors see this announcement and would like to update, please add the Chapter 4 Initial Event to your MOD and contact the administrators. In that case, the updated versions uploaded by us will be hidden.[/p][list][*][p]小川pro → 小川pro - Updated Version (Uploaded on September 22)[/p][/*][*][p]刽子手莫三 → Version 1.0 Executioner Mo San (Uploaded on April 22, thanks for support)[/p][/*][/list][p]If you still encounter issues entering Chapter 4 after updating your subscription, please report it in QQ group [b]609768905[/b], Discord, or leave a comment under the Steam announcement section. Thank you.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]MOD Translation Related[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]All MOD content (including character names, buffs, cards, MOD names, and MOD descriptions) requires translation support from the MOD creators.[/p][p]If the creators do not provide translation text, the original text will be displayed instead.[/p][p]The game will switch fonts based on the current language setting. If the selected language is not Simplified/Traditional Chinese, the original text (in Chinese) will be displayed, which may result in missing characters—this is expected behavior.[/p]

[*] Fixed a bug where using Chuan's "Hunt-and-Hit" rapidly could cause the game to freeze

[*] Fixed a bug where defeating the Old Dragon King would not unlock achievement
[*] Fixed the achievement "Until Next Time" unlocking even when no cards were drawn
[*] Fixed an issue where right-clicking card rarity in battle could incorrectly open the details view
[*] Fixed a discrepancy between the unlock condition and the description of ShaEr’s achievement "Shadow Shift Mirage"
[*] Fixed inconsistencies with matchmaking time in the Yao-Slaying Tower
[*] Fixed a bug where the custom option "Talented" would downgrade advanced Inner Skills to normal ones after refresh
[*] Fixed a missing description issue for Projectile
[*] Fixed incorrect text in the "Fist Chart"
[*] Fixed incorrect text in the "Pouch"
[/list]

Visual & UI Fixes
[list]

[*] Fixed incorrect visuals for the Old Dragon King boss
[*] Fixed misaligned rage text in Mo San’s Inner Skill "Enraged"
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing ESC in the character selection screen would cause other modes to lose UI text
[*] Fixed a missing icon for the custom option "One True Love"
[*] Fixed dialogue box text alignment issues

Language Fixes

[*] Fixed missing translation of “Swallow Card” for the Toad enemy
[*] Fixed missing translation of “Overheated” in Chuan’s Inner Skill
[*] Fixed missing translation of the keyword "Pray+" in the Japanese version
[/list]



We are aware of some volume-related issues and are actively working on fixes.
The language test version is expected to enter the test server later this week.

notes.title: Yao-Guai Hunter V1.0
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that the Early Access phase of the Wuxia-style deck-building game Yao-Guai Hunter has officially ended — Version 1.0 is now available! 
Whether you’re an old companion on the road or a newly arrived traveler, we hope you’ll enjoy the strange tales and fierce battles along the journey of demon hunting.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/907ea8ae534837d66da925e04c60032e2ccc536e.png[/img]

[h1]About the V1.0 Update[/h1]

Version 1.0 comes packed with new content and improvements — including a brand-new chapter, a new game ending, the long-awaited new character, along with many exclusive events, Inner Skills, elixirs, Steam achievements, and new entries in the codex with stories for monsters and cards.

As this is a major content update, cross-version compatibility issues may occur. After the update, you might need to restart the Steam client. If you encounter any problems, please try verifying the game files, or reinstalling the game.

Some mods may also become incompatible and require updates from their creators.

[h1]Full Update Details[/h1]

[h2]① New Chapter[/h2]
Yao-Siegel-Tower:
A hidden chapter located deep in the mountains behind the Kingdom of Yao.
Countless fearsome Yao-Guai are sealed inside this ancient tower.
You’ll need to collect a certain number of keys to open the gate.
New enemies, new challenges await!

[h2]② New  Character[/h2]
ShaEr:
A member of a mysterious family of tomb raiders, skilled in using ancient tools to fight demons.

77 available cards

46 unique Inner Skills

New character-exclusive events and elixirs
Available for free in the DLC store!

[h2]③ Codex Improvements[/h2]
The codex interface has been completely overhauled.

It’s now much easier to view cards and Inner Skills by character.

Card lore has been added.

Monster lore entries are now available as well.

[h2]④ Bug Fixes[/h2]
We’ve fixed a massive number of bugs and will continue to monitor and resolve any issues that arise.
There may still be some problems we’ve missed — feel free to report them at any time!

Fixes include:

[list]
[*] Fixed several softlock issues involving Ao Yu.
[*] Corrected the Inner Skill "Concentration" description for Ao Yu.
[*] Fixed Ao Yu not playing the death animation when killed by reflected damage during dragon form.
[*] Fixed a bug where Ao Yu’s charge-up cards could get stuck visually after electrocuting enemies.
[*] Fixed Ao Yu’s “Quick Freeze” card not properly granting armor when targeting himself while Old Fisherman is invisible.
[*] Fixed Mo San’s Inner Skill "Demonic Infusion" not matching its described effect.
[*] Fixed the description text on Mo San’s card “Revenge.”
[*] Fixed a bug with A-Zi’s Inner Skill "Devotion" where “Mirror Mirage” would crash the game when copying summoned units in the boss fight against the King of Yao.
[*] Fixed an issue where using pearls outside of combat would not reward silver.
[*] Fixed “Backstab” and “Torture” not properly triggering on Hydra heads.
[*] Fixed a bug where Old Fisherman’s stealth death was incorrectly showing attack animations.
[*] Fixed a shop bug where buying two elixirs quickly would cause the same card to upgrade twice.
[*] Fixed a card draw timing issue when enemies shuffled dirty cards into the draw pile.
[*] Fixed a problem where picking up two items rapidly could cause one to disappear.
[*] Fixed some UI elements being obstructed by health bars.
[*] Fixed “Demonic Elixir” and “Raging Emotions” not appearing on the battle result screen.
[*] Fixed a visual bug where the chapter loading animation played twice.
[/list]

[h2]⑤Language[/h2]
After a period of proofreading and testing, the English localization of the game has improved significantly compared to before. 
However, some issues still remain, and we warmly welcome any feedback or suggestions in this regard.



[h1]What’s Next?[/h1]
The development of Yao-Guai Hunter has been full of surprises — not least of which is the passion and support from our amazing players.
We still have a mountain of ideas we haven’t had the chance to implement, including new cards, Inner Skills, events, and elixirs for existing characters, and even brand-new heroes.
Creating this content is a joy, and we hope to bring more of it to you very soon!

notes.title: Future update content roadmap
notes.content:
With the game still being in early access, we had managed to reach a total sale of over 20k! Yeah!
And with the community and player base all wanting a clearer picture of what's to come, here's the list of contents of the future.


[b]1， New Character：Dragon Maiden（Still working on the name）[/b]

Well, basically the stereotypical type of , young (kinda around 78 years old, which IS quite young for them), Chinese dragon girl, the type that can command and summon thunder and lightning and all that.The younger sister of Ao Xue. Fights with various spells and dragon wizardry.

[i]（Character design concept）[/i]

[b]2，Creature encyclopedia and backstories[/b]

Will be making a sort of a monster/creature encyclopedia as well as a bit of a short write up on the background and backstory of the Yao Guais.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/24745d21da45c4a9a690b988285d1e2cb89975b8.jpg[/img]
[i]（Encyclopeida sample, still a work in progress）[/i]

[b]3，Steam workshop[/b]
Though even the dev (since this is the translator typing) have no idea on anyone that is out there that could make some mod for the game, but due to popular demand, Steam Workshop will be added.

[b]4，OST Album[/b]
Ah yes, this one is to be sold, though....how much? Maybe we are gonna tweak some of the OSTs and even make an album cover of sorts, will be out very soon.

[b]5，Customized mode and daily challenge[/b]
Got the feeling that there won't be a lot of players that are keen with this kind of things but will be adding these two mods in time.
Will be out soon, too.

[b]6，Additional Contents[/b]
Because of certain gut feeling about the game getting a bit too repetitive
So we have decided to add a fourth boss per chapter (basically a miniboss)
This will take some time...
Actual, actual boss will be 3 per chapter, and as of now chapter 2/3 is still missing one, so will be adding that too.

[b]7，Uncertain contents[/b]
Not too sure about the addition of another chapter, more or less will be making those, but might get distracted with the designing of those new action cards instead....
After we are done with character 4....maybe we will be working on a fifth character...but we are really not sure if new character would increase sales...is there really people out there that wants new character? 
Really, really want to add in more character (but character design is hard)...
That would be more or less it....unless the dev had forgotten something...will be updating this log if there is anything...



OH, right !

[b]8，Battlelogs and Player stats[/b]
Basically a log on what cards had been used and all that, almost done with this too.

notes.title: Test Mode: Speedrun
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42690210/9da4d23694e6d7402833e5fdf80a1df2bc31f95d.png[/img]
We have a new test mode: Speedrun, in which you can play with other players.

Here is the rule of Speedrun:

Create and join the lobby:
1. Select the Challange(Testing)-Speedrun on the main page to join the lobby. If you cannot find an existing lobby, you will create one instead.
2. When another player join the lobby, there will be a 60 sec countdown before everyone can go.
3. There can be at most 4 players in one lobby. If a player leaves and the lobby has only one player left; then the countdown will reset.
4. The lobby would close when countdown is 10s; after that, players cannot join that lobby.
5. PS: if the countdown suddenly stops, it might due to bad connection to steam. Please wait minutes or try rematch.

During the speedrun:  
1. All players starts the game with the same character, map and event seed.
2. The Yao Aura is fix to be 5.
3. You can check the score of each players. The score is affected by the battles and events each player meet. Because it's the test mode, the score has nothing to do with the victory conditions now. 
4. You can check the position of every players. 

How to win:
1. Whenever a player defeat the Yao-Guai King in the Stage 3, that player win the game and other players lose immediately.
2. Whenever a player is defeated or leave the lobby, that player lose the game. It means that you cannot S/L in this mode.
3. If there is only one player undefeated in the lobby, that player win the game immediately.
4. The Speedrun mode would not effect the save file and the unlock progress.

notes.title: 版本更新 4月9日凌晨4点
notes.content:
[h3]平衡性[/h3]
1.给巨蚌添加了一个逃跑提示
2.给河神施放洪水添加了一个提示，降低了将玩家拖入水中后，河妖戍卫的攻击数值
3.提升了第三章狼王以及羊大仙的难度


[h3]问题修复[/h3]
1.在浏览卡组界面添加一个拖拽功能，方便steamdeck玩家浏览到卡组下侧的牌
2.试着优化了在游戏后期频繁卡顿的问题
3.修改了阿紫使用蛛丝缠绕后快速打出其他牌会导致出牌卡死的问题
4.修改了随心可能只出一个心法的问题
5.修改了伤害1的牌被虚弱时显示打0的问题
6.修改了战斗中看牌组里的牌的详情，伤害会显示0的问题
7.修改了部分与实际效果不符的文本，例如阿紫的天赋 请神上身，卡牌 扎小人 等
8.修改了主菜单图鉴无法查看卡牌详情的问题
9.修改了变大变小过的牌在升级界面显示不正确的问题
10.全屏现在会自动先调成1920*1080分辨率了，这个一定程度上会解决部分玩家全屏分辨率模糊的问题
11.现在在行动力充盈的时候会使当前行动力变为浅绿色





[h3]其他[/h3]
我们正在进行成就功能的制作，现在会在商店显示无法解锁的隐藏成就，这个是正常现象，理论上目前还无法解锁任何成就。
预计在下周我们将上线成就系统。

notes.title: 版本更新 4月7日凌晨2点
notes.content:
[h3]内容更新[/h3]
增加了2个新的心法
1.小川 灵敏 闪避的几率提升到90%
2.阿紫 采蜜 召唤胡蜂或鬼蛾时，抽2张牌

[h3]平衡性改动[/h3]
1.玄龟的灵力5→4，获得的护甲7→8（升级后 10→11）
2.阿紫 心法 蜘蛛诱饵 0费，召唤1个蜘蛛，CD3回合→0费，召唤2个蜘蛛，CD3回合。

[h3]问题修复[/h3]
1.修复了阿紫的心法 随心 随机出主动技能时，主动技能无法正常获得的问题
2.修复了阿紫的心法 随心 会随机出重复心法的问题
3.修复了一个可能会导致黑屏无限loading的问题
4.在设置加了个屏幕震动钩
5.修复了一个探索小岛会得到其他职业道具的问题
6.调整了碗妖的场景，避免碗妖的状态栏会被拒马遮挡
7.解决了邪剑魔脱发的问题
8.修复了血斩波不正确显示伤害数值的问题
9.修复了小川心法 事先准备 会给九头蛇上过多瞄准层数的问题
10.修复了小川射击九头蛇蛇头时，本体瞄准层数不掉的问题
以及一些其他改动

[h3]以下问题会在近期内修复[/h3]
1.在升级变大变小牌时，预览框的描述不正确的问题。实际升级并不会丢失变大变小这个属性，这个只是显示问题。
2.在变小一张0费牌或变小牌变为0费会无法打出
3.我们会在近期在浏览卡组界面添加一个拖拽功能，方便steamdeck玩家浏览到卡组下侧的牌
4.基础伤害为1的牌在被虚弱后显示伤害为0
5.各种弃牌规则没有统一
6.夜观天象拿到变大的牌后，变大效果消失
7.使用小川心法 无念无想 没有触发 稳扎稳打 的回费效果
8.阿紫打出蛛丝缠绕后快速打出一张其他牌，会导致所有牌都卡死无法正常打出的问题

notes.title: 版本更新 4月5日下午2点
notes.content:
感谢大家的支持！我们对大家反馈的bug和问题进行了一些修复。

虽然程序已经在爆肝修BUG了，但是游戏里应该还是多少会存在一些问题的，希望大家体谅一下，我们也会在后续的几天进行问题修复的！

以下是更新内容：

1.修复了在抽牌堆没牌时使用蓄谋会卡死的问题
2.现在浏览图鉴会正确的显示不同职业费用的颜色了
3.修复了在战斗中选牌时可以按esc导致游戏崩溃的问题
4.修复了阿紫天赋 剥离 在击杀敌人后没有抽1张牌的问题
5.修复了一个会引起阿紫使用补天诀无法正常回费的问题
6.修复了设置全屏模式退出重进后会变窗口模式的问题
7.修改了两个会遮挡住敌人信息的战斗场景，这类场景还有很多，会在后续版本中一一修复
8.移除了主界面的删除存档按键
9.修复了在部分情况下，选择心法时没有标签说明的问题
10.修复了音效设置不生效的问题
11.修改了第三关头目 熊妖怪的机制，现在使用召唤物牌不会给熊生气计数
12.修复了在与第三关头目 熊妖怪战斗时，丢弃投掷物或通过乱舞打出牌时会给熊生气计数的问题
13.现在默认将解锁小川，阿紫的解锁条件改为 任意通关莫三或小川
以及一些其他的更改
